_doc: PULLBACK-HOLD-BULL-TRIGGER -- FROZEN pre-registration, written BEFORE any grid run. Source: automation/overnight/queue.md PULLBACK-HOLD-BULL-TRIGGER item + markdown/doctrine/DOJO-HARVEST-2026-07-21.md. No field in this file may be edited after the grid runs; a changed definition requires a NEW dated pre-reg file, never an edit to this one.
root_cause: The engine's only high-conviction bull trigger (ELITE level_reclaim) is structurally LATE -- a reclaim by definition fires after the move has already happened, so block_elite_bull (needed to kill late/extended tops) also kills the whole bull lane on genuine up days. PULLBACK-HOLD is a NEW, EARLIER entry vocabulary: a higher-low that HOLDS inside a known level's zone, then reclaims the zone top -- $2-3 earlier than level_reclaim can ever fire.

candidates_considered: session trend (NOT selected -- redundant with the two above, dropped to respect the pick-2-max cap)
up_structure_qualifier.market_structure_impl: crypto.lib.market_structure.analyze_structure over a trailing 60-bar (structure_lookback_bars), day-local, no-look-ahead window ending at the candidate bar; qualifies when read.trend == 'uptrend'.
up_structure_qualifier.price_vwap_impl: session-anchored VWAP (resets at 09:30 ET each day, cumulative typical-price*volume / cumulative volume, same convention as crypto/lib/indicators.vwap and crypto/lib/confluence._session_vwap); qualifies when bar close > vwap-so-far.
up_structure_qualifier.evaluated_at: the pullback-low candidate bar itself (bar j) -- NOT continuously required through the hold window, since a shallow pullback can transiently break intraday structure without invalidating the setup. Disclosed simplification, not hidden.

known_level_source.choice: backtest.lib.watchers.level_memory.LevelMemory (stateless, look-ahead-safe, multi-day horizontal level engine; setup/scripts/level_memory_producer.py is the LIVE producer that merges this exact engine's output into key-levels.json since the 2026-07-09 G11 wiring -- confirmed the live producer import). Levels used regardless of computed role (support/resistance) -- both exhibits touch levels whose role flickers across bars near the touch, so gating on role would be an invented extra parameter, not a reuse of an existing gate.
known_level_source.rejected_alternative: backtest.lib.levels.detect_levels_at_bar (the OLDER backtest-only S/R approximation used by orchestrator.py for the full historical-backtest engine) was considered and REJECTED for this study: its own docstring says it is an approximation ('In production, levels are written by premarket... For backtest, we approximate from price history alone') and it does NOT reproduce the level cited in J's own 07-22 exhibit text ('a KNOWN level_memory level at 746.54') -- verified this fire: detect_levels_at_bar's active set near that bar/time does not contain a level within a few cents of 746.54, while LevelMemory.levels_at() does (746.59, memory_score 160, support) -- LevelMemory is the faithful reusable proxy for what levels_context/key-levels.json actually carries today.
known_level_source.params: LevelMemory module defaults unchanged (SWING_HALF=2, CLUSTER_TOL=0.35, TOUCH_TOL=0.20, BREAK_MARGIN=0.15, DEFAULT_LOOKBACK_DAYS=5) -- these are the live producer's own tuned constants, not re-tuned here (reuse, not invent).

zone_band_width.rule: fixed-cents grid, per feedback_levels_are_zones (band width is a pre-registered A/B axis, never hand-picked) -- symmetric zone [level - band, level + band].
zone_band_width.selected_for_grid: fixed cents {0.15, 0.25, 0.40} only -- the ATR-fraction axis was dropped (not invented-then-hidden, disclosed here) purely to keep the grid within the <=36 cell cap once crossed with the other 3 axes; the fixed-cents axis alone already spans the same qualitative range (tight/medium/wide) the ATR-fraction axis would have targeted.

hold_condition.rule: pullback low enters the zone (bar low within [level-band, level+band]) AND price closes back above zone_top (level+band) within N bars of the pullback-low bar, checked over bars [j, j+N] inclusive (so N=1 allows the reclaim on the very next bar after the low).

candidates: RSI(14) dipped <= 55 within the trailing 6 bars before entry (J's 07-21 dojo observation)
green close on the entry (reclaim) bar
confirmation_features.grid_axis: confirm_mode in {NONE, BOTH} -- NOT 4 independent ON/OFF combinations (which would need 4x this axis and blow the 36-cell cap with the other 3 axes at their full pre-registered sizes); BOTH requires RSI-reset AND green-close together. Frozen BEFORE running, disclosed simplification, not a post-hoc choice.
confirmation_features.rsi_impl: Wilder RSI(14), continuous multi-day series (crypto/lib/indicators-equivalent ewm alpha=1/14 convention, same math as backtest/autoresearch/rsi_extension_block_probe._wilder_rsi -- reused, not re-derived), computed on the full multi-day close series so RSI has proper multi-day warmup (never a per-day cold start).

exit_shape.base: automation/state/fleet/strategies.py RIBBON_RIDE.exit (SS-B validated cell) -- SAME for every cell, entry is the only thing being tuned.
exit_shape.structure_stop_reference: trigger_level passed to walk_exit_manager = zone_low (level - band), i.e. 'stop below the zone' per the mission spec -- calls exit when a closed 5m bar closes below zone_low (backtest/lib/exit_manager_walk.py + automation/state/fleet/exit_manager.py::_structure_stop_hit side=='C' semantics: exit when close < trigger_level).

entry_pricing.strike: ATM per live tier -- crypto.lib.strike_selection.pick_strike via automation/state/fleet/fleet_executor._tiers_for_arm on accounts.json arm 'safe-2' (V15_SAFE_TIERS, matches CLAUDE.md 'core Safe trades ATM' doctrine)
entry_pricing.qty: min(params.json min_contracts=3, fleet risk_gate.max_affordable_qty(equity=safe-2 starting_equity, premium=entry_premium, params=params.json))
entry_pricing.fill: next 5-min OPRA option bar's VWAP at/after the entry (reclaim) bar's timestamp, via backtest.lib.option_pricing_real.bar_at_or_after -- same convention as every other real-fills study in this codebase.
entry_pricing.exit_walk: backtest.lib.exit_manager_walk.walk_exit_manager -- the REAL production exit_manager.plan_exit_actions decision core, tick-by-tick over the 5-min option series, ribbon 'stack' series from backtest.lib.ribbon.compute_ribbon over the full continuous close series (proper EMA-48 warmup, no per-day reset).

populations.full_history_source: backtest/data/spy_5m_2026-05-19_2026-07-22.csv (single continuous file, most complete range available)
populations.held_out_days_rule: chronological tail, last 25% of opra_covered_days by date (round(39*0.25)=10), frozen here, never chosen after seeing results
populations.disclosure: Detector-frequency stats (how often each cell fires, structurally) are reported over the FULL 44-day history. Dollar P&L / expectancy / the ship gate are computed ONLY over the 39 OPRA-covered days (real option fills) -- 2026-07-20/21/22 are detector-frequency-only (no cached OPRA contracts yet), never counted toward the ship gate, per C1 (real-fills is the only WR authority).

ship_bar._doc: A cell only SHIPS if it clears-all-gates. Computed ONLY on the 39-day OPRA-covered real-fills population.
ship_bar.condition_2_majority_of_covered_days_win: day-total P&L > 0 on a strict majority of days this cell produced >=1 real-fills entry
ship_bar.condition_3_survives_dropping_best_trade: total P&L minus the single largest-P&L trade is still > 0
ship_bar.condition_4_holds_on_held_out_subset: the held_out_days subset (last 10 OPRA days, never touched during tuning) has positive total P&L for this cell
ship_bar.condition_5_bh_fdr: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at q=0.10 across all 36 cells' one-sample significance test (mean P&L != 0) -- multiplicity correction across the whole grid, mandatory because 36 cells were tested.
ship_bar.cell_disqualified_if: the cell cannot produce a PULLBACK-HOLD entry event matching BOTH named sanity anchors below (fidelity check, evaluated BEFORE the ship-bar dollar gates) -- regardless of how good its aggregate P&L looks.
verdict_labels: NO_CELL_SHIPS (honest null -- report best near-miss + exact failed gate)

sanity_anchors._doc: Fidelity checks, not P&L checks. A disqualifying cell fails regardless of aggregate.

anchor_1.description: higher-low ~746.80 over a known level_memory level ~746.54 (verified this fire: LevelMemory finds a support cluster at 746.59, memory_score 160, one bar prior to the low)
anchor_1.requirement: cell must emit >=1 PULLBACK-HOLD entry (reclaim/entry bar) with entry timestamp inside the window on this date

anchor_2.description: shelf 745.77-745.85 (three taps: 10:40 L745.77, 11:00 L745.83, 11:05 L745.85) then 11:15 CLOSE 747.41 above the 10:30/10:45 highs (verified this fire: LevelMemory finds a persistent support cluster ~745.60-745.89 across this window)
anchor_2.requirement: cell must emit >=1 PULLBACK-HOLD entry with entry timestamp inside the window on this date

no_post_hoc_tuning: The grid, populations, ship bar, and sanity anchors above are fixed at this file's write time. The replay tool may not adjust any of these after seeing results; a changed definition requires a new dated pre-reg.
